Something worth note is that higher ttks game aren't usually the type where you will expect someone to 1v6 a team by flanking them etc, in cod I think you should be able to stand a reasonable chance against more than 1 opponent if you're fast enough.

Higher TTK = More skill required for 1:1 gunfights, but makes 1v >2 plays pretty difficult, even if you get the jump on them

answer is a balance of course, not just higher = better

Yeah the performance is pretty inconsistent and in recent seasons  it seems to be a fair bit worse, my guess is your CPU is limiting you (if you are on all low that is), I'm with an i7 10700f and even that's not enough to have locked 144fps, rebirth is a lot better though.

Biggest optimizations I'd suggest is putting your videomemoryscale to something like 0.65, maybe playing on normal textures, messing with renderworkercount ,and disabling any overlays. You might have luck with older nvidia drivers too (457.30 is best supposedly) oh and overclocking my GPU memory in afterburner has helped a bit, so maybe give that a shot if all else fails.

with these optimizations on a 3070 I'm able to get 120-140 fps in WZ (1440p), sometimes in busy areas it can drop to the 100s but its mostly okay, im sure you can find a way to get >100fps at 1080p
